intent_signatures: build out the cell architecture described in docs/endpoint-as-cell.md
every gap in the doc becomes a child cell with its own verification
harness is the pre-prod gate: do not ship anything until every child cell is green
usage_instructions: Run scripts/cell-build/check.sh. Green means every child cell passed its verify.sh. Yellow or red means work remains and nothing should ship.

history.summary: [build-goal] state.json missing — run check.sh at least once

notes: The build-goal cell IS this request. Its verification walks every child cell in scripts/cell-build/cells/ and succeeds only when all of them pass. This makes the request itself a harness primitive — Lewis's instruction: 'make this request a harness primitive itself'.
